# Tag

A grey chip with a price-tag icon, used for an applied discount code. It pops in from half size with a small overshoot over 400ms.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/tag)

## Usage

```tsx
<Tag onRemove={removeDiscount} removeLabel="Remove discount">WELCOME10</Tag>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The code or text. |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` | Adds the round remove button. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | Accessible name of the remove button. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | Replaces the price-tag icon; null for none. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Tag.module.css`
- `Tag.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
